Model Description

Phrozen XP Finder

Content : 1 model 1 part.

The Phrozen XP Finder is a free 3D print test model designed by Phrozen to test the resin exposure and parameter settings. It was designed with ten different parts to help creators check on their exposure and settings. 

It's best to make sure that you have achieved perfect exposure with the XP Finder before printing bigger models to avoid wasting resin and time on a failed print. Each XP Finder can be printed in less than 30 minutes with a minimum amount of resin, so you don’t need to wait long before getting into those amazing 3D models you’ve been dying to print.
